priorityList: Ensure Arcane Intellect is active and summon your Water Elemental before combat.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials alongside Frozen Orb or Ray of Frost.
Cast Comet Storm if the Splinterstorm buff is not active.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active (prioritize using it outside of Thermal Void).
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate Fingers of Frost and Splinters.
Cast Ice Lance if Fingers of Frost is active.
Cast Glacial Spike when you have 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 6 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff from Splinterstorm.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown.
Cast Flurry if you have charges available to apply Winter's Chill.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler to generate Icicles and procs.
During movement, use Blink/Shimmer or Ice Lance if no other instant casts are available.
Use Ray of Frost as an execute if the target is about to die (under 12 seconds).
Cast Ice Lance as an execute if the target is about to die (under 2 seconds).
